<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Supplier invoice format rejection",
 "problem_statement": "Users cannot upload supplier invoices because the system rejects specific file formats. This blocks the claims process and prevents valid documents from being processed."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 1,
 "mentions_n": 1,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "support": 1
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 210000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 0,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Cindermill Trade Cover",
   "arr_gbp": 210000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-04-03",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "e32f8ad103cb7bbe",
  "quote": "the system won’t accept the supplier’s invoice format",
  "account": "Cindermill Trade Cover",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-09-06T16:41:00+00:00"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Users cannot upload supplier invoices because the system rejects specific file formats. This blocks the claims process and prevents valid documents from being processed. One customer, Cindermill Trade Cover, reported on 2026-09-06 that the system would not accept the supplier's invoice format [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe]. The only route recording this signal is support, with 1 mention [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].

## Who is affected

- Cindermill Trade Cover, which holds an ARR of £210000.0 and renews on 2027-04-03 [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].
- 1 account in total, carrying 1 mention across 1 route, so the evidence base is narrow [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].

## Evidence

- Support route: 1 mention, tied to Cindermill Trade Cover [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].
- The customer's own words: "the system won’t accept the supplier’s invoice format" [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].
- The mention was logged on 2026-09-06T16:41:00+00:00 [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].
- The fact sheet records 0 renewals in the next 90 days, so this is not attached to an imminent renewal decision [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].

## Why now

- The report dates from 2026-09-06 and remains the only recorded instance, with 1 account, 1 mention and 1 route in the fact sheet as of 2026-11-03 [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].
- No renewal falls within the next 90 days, so there is no renewal-driven deadline forcing action [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].
- The absence of wider evidence should be weighed alongside the single report before treating this as a broader pattern [i:e32f8ad103cb7bbe].", "citations": ["e32f8ad103cb7bbe"]}
